title: Developer Experience portfolio calendar and evidence hub
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a centralized portfolio calendar and an 'evidence hub' for all Developer Experience initiatives (SDKs, docs, quickstarts). The calendar will surface milestones, rollout windows, and stakeholder owners across cycles. The evidence hub will collect launch artifacts, evaluation signals (activation, retention, NPS), PRDs, design specs, telemetry dashboards, and post-rollout retros so PMs and Eng can make faster prioritization and incident decisions. This ticket is to scope the MVP, define the signal contract, and deliver a lightweight implementation (Notion + shared Drive + observable links) and a migration path to Console-based dashboards in H2.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar MVP published with per-initiative rows and owners for next 4 cycles
Evidence hub template created and populated for 10 active DX initiatives
Signal contract doc (activation, 7d retention, error-rate, latency, cost-per-inference) approved by Eng and DX leads
Automation added: weekly sync extracts key metrics links into the hub (manual links OK for MVP)
Hand-off runbook for on-call and rollout owners describing where to find artifacts and escalation paths
notes: Initial proposal discussed in PM guild on 2025-10-02. Feedback: keep MVP lightweight, avoid building new infra before validating adoption.
Trade-offs: Start with Notion + Drive + a shared dashboard index vs building Console integration. Chosen approach reduces dev effort and accelerates adoption testing.
Open questions: ownership model for maintaining calendar rows; proposed: rotating curator per cycle (PM + Eng lead).
UX ask: design to create a compact view that correlates milestone dates with rollout readiness checklist. Filed separate design request (DES-921).
Privacy: only include non-sensitive telemetry links for public initiative pages; sensitive customer dashboards will be access-restricted and referenced by name.
Estimated cross-team work: Eng (1.5 pt) to expose quick telemetry links, DX Analytics (2 pt) to backfill metric cards, Docs (1 pt) to curate content.
decisions: MVP content will live in a Notion calendar + a linked Drive folder for artifacts (decision 2025-10-06)
Signal contract will standardize on activation, 7-day retention, 30-day retention, first-call success rate, and errors per 10k calls
Post-rollout retros will require a one-paragraph summary and 3 key metrics posted to the hub within 10 days of launch
risks: Low adoption if maintenance becomes manual — mitigate by automating link extraction in cycle-2
Confusion over which dashboards are canonical; mitigate by labeling canonical links and adding owner metadata
Duplication with existing program trackers — mitigate via discovery with Growth PMs and Developer Relations (meeting 2025-10-09)
next_steps: Draft Notion calendar template and evidence hub folder structure (owner: Omar) — due 2025-10-12
Workshop with Eng, DX Analytics, and Docs to finalize signal contract (meeting set 2025-10-14)
Pilot: onboard 5 active initiatives into the hub (target: 2025-11-01)
Collect feedback during pilot and iterate; prepare H2 roadmap proposal for Console integration based on adoption signals
